definitions.explanation: Humble term used when referring to one's own mother when speaking to others outside the family.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{料理|りょうり}が{上手|じょうず}です。
examples.english: My mother is good at cooking.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{教師|きょうし}です。
{母|はは}の{日|ひ}にプレゼントをあげました。
examples.english: I gave a present on Mother's Day.

notes:
Use {母|はは} when speaking about your own mother to others. Use お{母|かあ}さん when addressing your mother directly or speaking about someone else's mother.

Related: {父|ちち} (father - humble).
